page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Greek-letter-free Italian and Latin grammatical paradigms; no marginal notes; page number and running head at top.

main_text.head: Optatiuus modus, Tempus præsens, & futurum.
main_text.p: O Dio vóglia, vel Dio vóglia, vel o' che, vel o' Dio che.
main_text.head: Præteritum perfectum.
main_text.p: O' Dio voléfse, vel Dio voléfse, vel o' Dio che vel o' che.
main_text.head: Idem tempus aliter declinatum.
main_text.p: O' che: huic nanque tempori, isto altero modo

page.notes: Greek-like Ἀ marks are printed as the Latin letter A with an acute accent (rendered here as Ἀ in some cases); the heading "Optatiuus modus, Tempus præsens" is set in larger type. Several verb forms are heavily hand-marked with accents; readings of the accents are approximate.
